results.name: THE ALL TOO WELL
results.tagline: You kept the scarf. Obviously you kept the scarf.
results.blurb: You were the relationship that gets a ten-minute version. You remember the kitchen, the exact month, the light in the hallway, and one small detail that has ruined every autumn since. You are not over it. You are, in fact, deeply and articulately not over it, and honestly the art is better for it.
results.watchOut: You keep the memory alive longer than the person deserved. Put the scarf away.

results.name: THE STYLE
results.tagline: You looked incredible and it meant nothing
results.blurb: You are the one people remember at the party: good coat, better exit, mutual friends still arguing about what actually happened. It was never going to be permanent and you both knew it, which somehow made it better. You leave a rumour and a very good photograph.
results.watchOut: You'd rather be iconic than honest. Let one person see past the styling.

results.name: THE FOREVER AND ALWAYS
results.tagline: Twenty seconds on the phone and a whole song after
results.blurb: You ended it fast, clean and in a way that has been described, at length, in public. You did not mean to be the villain of somebody's best chorus. You just wanted it over before it got worse. You have been apologising for a decision you would make again ever since.
results.watchOut: Efficiency without kindness gets written down. Have the longer conversation.

results.name: THE BACK TO DECEMBER
results.tagline: Lovely, brief, and permanently in the past tense
results.blurb: You were the good one. That is the problem. Nothing went wrong, it just went, and now every December you get a small, polite mention in someone's best work. You are the relationship people describe as 'actually really nice', which is both a compliment and a strange kind of erasure.
strengths: Leaves people better than you found them
results.watchOut: Being the safe one is not the same as being chosen. Ask for what you want.

results.name: THE GETAWAY CAR
results.tagline: It was never going to work, and it was the best night of the year
results.blurb: You arrived in a blaze of good tailoring and terrible timing. Everybody warned them. They did it anyway. You are the story they tell at the end of the night, the one with the sirens and the hotel bill, and nobody involved has ever entirely regretted it.
strengths: Makes life feel like a film
results.watchOut: The drama is not a foundation. Leave before it becomes the whole point.

results.name: THE EXILE
results.tagline: Quiet, long, and nobody saw the ending
results.blurb: You were in it for years, out of the public eye, and the breakup arrived so gradually that neither of you can name the day. You do not do scenes. You do not do statements. You just get up, take the dog, and let an entire era end without raising your voice once.
results.watchOut: Silence can read as coldness. Say the difficult thing before it's too late.

results.name: THE DEAR JOHN
results.tagline: You were older, and it shows
results.blurb: You were the one who should have known better, and someone wrote a very long, very specific song about why. You are thoughtful, articulate and entirely convinced you meant well. Somewhere in a drawer there is a letter, and it is a really good letter, and it does not help your case.
results.watchOut: Explaining why you did it is not the same as apologising for it.

results.name: THE TORTURED POET
results.tagline: It was brief, it was messy, it got an entire album
results.blurb: You are the one that made no sense to anyone outside the room and complete sense to everyone inside it. It burned bright, it ended badly, it came back for a second go, and it has since been documented track by track. You are chaos with good taste, and you know exactly what you are doing.
results.watchOut: You keep the door open just enough to stop anyone healing. Close it properly.
